St. Pete Critical Mass

St. Petersburg, FL · Downtown · Social

St. Pete Critical Mass is a social group ride in St. Petersburg, FL. It rolls last Friday of the month at 7:30 pm from Williams Park fountain. Pace: 10–12 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10–12 mph: you can talk the whole way.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the St. Pete Critical Mass group ride

Monthly social ride through downtown St. Pete at 10 to 12 mph for about an hour. Helmets and lights strongly encouraged. Meets at the fountain in Williams Park.
